text_en: One sabbath while Jesus was going through the grainfields, his disciples plucked some heads of grain, rubbed them in their hands, and ate them.
text_cn: 有一个安息日，耶稣经过麦田时，他的门徒掐了麦穗，用手搓着吃。

text_en: But some of the Pharisees said, “Why are you doing what is not lawful on the sabbath? ”
text_cn: 有几个法利塞人说：“为什么你们做安息日不准做的呢？”

text_en: Jesus answered, “Have you not read what David did when he and his companions were hungry?
text_cn: 耶稣回答说：“你们没有读过：达味和同他在一起的人，在饥饿时所做的吗？

text_en: He entered the house of God and took and ate the bread of the Presence, which it is not lawful for any but the priests to eat, and gave some to his companions? ”
text_cn: 他怎样进了天主的殿，拿起供饼来吃了，又给了同他在一起的人吃。这供饼原不准他人吃，而只准司祭吃。”

text_en: Then he said to them, “The Son of Man is lord of the sabbath. ”
text_cn: 耶稣又向他们说：“人子是安息日的主。”

text_en: On another sabbath he entered the synagogue and taught, and there was a man there whose right hand was withered.
text_cn: 另一个安息日，他进了会堂施教。在那里一个人，他的右手干枯了。

text_en: The scribes and the Pharisees watched him to see whether he would cure on the sabbath, so that they might find an accusation against him.
text_cn: 经师和法利塞人窥察他是否在安息日治病，好寻隙控告他。

text_en: Even though he knew what they were thinking, he said to the man who had the withered hand, “Come and stand here. ” He got up and stood there.
text_cn: 他看透了他们的心思，就对那枯了手的人说：“起来！站在中间！”他遂站了起来。

text_en: Then Jesus said to them, “I ask you, is it lawful to do good or to do harm on the sabbath, to save life or to destroy it? ”
text_cn: 耶稣对他们说：“我问你们：安息日是许行善呢？还是许作恶呢？是救命呢？还是丧命呢？”

text_en: After looking around at all of them, he said to him, “Stretch out your hand. ” He did so, and his hand was restored.
text_cn: 他环视众人一周，就对那人说：“伸出你的手来！”那人照样一做，他的手便复了原。

text_en: But they were filled with fury and discussed with one another what they might do to Jesus.
text_cn: 他们竟狂怒填胸，彼此商议，要怎样来对付耶稣。

text_en: Now during those days he went out to the mountain to pray; and he spent the night in prayer to God.
text_cn: 在这几天，耶稣出去，上山祈祷；他彻夜向天主祈祷。

text_en: And when day came, he called his disciples and chose twelve of them, whom he also named apostles:
text_cn: 天一亮，他把门徒叫来，由他们中拣选了十二人，并称他们为宗徒：

text_en: Simon, whom he named Peter, and his brother Andrew, and James, and John, and Philip, and Bartholomew,
text_cn: 即西满，耶稣又给他起名叫伯多禄，和他的兄弟安德肋、雅各伯、若望、斐理伯、巴尔多禄茂、

text_en: and Matthew, and Thomas, and James son of Alphaeus, and Simon, who was called the Zealot,
text_cn: 玛窦、多默、阿耳斐的儿子雅各伯、号称“热诚者”的西满、

text_en: and Judas son of James, and Judas Iscariot, who became a traitor.
text_cn: 雅各伯的兄弟犹达和犹达斯依斯加略，他成了负卖者。

text_en: He came down with them and stood on a level place, with a great crowd of his disciples and a great multitude of people from all Judea, Jerusalem, and the coast of Tyre and Sidon.
text_cn: 耶稣同他们下山，站在一块平地上，有他的一大群门徒和很多从犹太、耶路撒冷及提洛和漆冬海边来的群众，

text_en: They had come to hear him and to be healed of their diseases; and those who were troubled with unclean spirits were cured.
text_cn: 他们来是为听他讲道，并为治好自己的病症；那些被邪魔缠扰的人都被治好了。

text_en: And all in the crowd were trying to touch him, for power came out from him and healed all of them.
text_cn: 群众都设法触摸他，因为有一种能力从他身上出来，治好众人。

text_en: Then he looked up at his disciples and said: “Blessed are you who are poor, for yours is the kingdom of God.
text_cn: 耶稣举目望着自己的门徒说： “你们贫穷的是有福的，因为天主的国是你们的。

text_en: “Blessed are you who are hungry now, for you will be filled. “Blessed are you who weep now, for you will laugh.
text_cn: 你们现今饥饿的是有福的，因为你们将得饱饫（yù）。 你们现今哭泣的是有福的，因为你们将要欢笑。

text_en: “Blessed are you when people hate you, and when they exclude you, revile you, and defame you on account of the Son of Man.
text_cn: 几时，为了人子的原故，人恼恨你们，并弃绝你们，并且以你们的名字为可恶的，而加以辱骂诅咒，你们才是有福的。

text_en: Rejoice in that day and leap for joy, for surely your reward is great in heaven; for that is what their ancestors did to the prophets.
text_cn: 在那一天，你们欢喜踊跃罢！看，你们的赏报在天上是丰厚的，因为他们的祖先也同样对待了先知。

text_en: “But woe to you who are rich, for you have received your consolation.
text_cn: 但是，你们富有的是有祸的；因为你们已经获得了你们的安慰。

text_en: “Woe to you who are full now, for you will be hungry. “Woe to you who are laughing now, for you will mourn and weep.
text_cn: 你们现今饱饫的是有祸的，因为你们将要饥饿。 你们现今欢笑的是有祸的，因为你们将要哀恸（tòng）哭泣。

text_en: “Woe to you when all speak well of you, for that is what their ancestors did to the false prophets.
text_cn: 几时，众人都夸赞你们，你们是有祸的，因为他们的祖先也同样对待了假先知。”

text_en: “But I say to you that listen, Love your enemies, do good to those who hate you,
text_cn: 但是，我给你们这些听众说：“应爱你们的仇人，善待恼恨你们的人；

text_en: bless those who curse you, pray for those who abuse you.
text_cn: 应祝福诅咒你们的人，为毁谤你们的人祈祷。

text_en: If anyone strikes you on the cheek, offer the other also; and from anyone who takes away your coat do not withhold even your shirt.
text_cn: 有人打你的面颊，也把另一面转给他；有人拿去你的外衣，也不要阻挡他拿你的内衣。

text_en: Give to everyone who begs from you; and if anyone takes away your goods, do not ask for them again.
text_cn: 凡求你的，就给他；有人拿去你的东西，别再索回。

text_en: Do to others as you would have them do to you.
text_cn: 你们愿意人怎样待你们，也要怎样待人。

text_en: “If you love those who love you, what credit is that to you? For even sinners love those who love them.
text_cn: 若你们爱那爱你们的，为你们还算什么功德？因为连罪人也爱那爱他们的人。

text_en: If you do good to those who do good to you, what credit is that to you? For even sinners do the same.
text_cn: 你们善待那善待你们的，为你们还算什么功德？因为连罪人也这样作。

text_en: If you lend to those from whom you hope to receive, what credit is that to you? Even sinners lend to sinners, to receive as much again.
text_cn: 你们若借给那些有希望偿还的，为你们还算什么功德？就是罪人也借给罪人，为能如数收回。

text_en: But love your enemies, do good, and lend, expecting nothing in return. Your reward will be great, and you will be children of the Most High; for he is kind to the ungrateful and the wicked.
text_cn: 但是，你们当爱你们的仇人，善待他们；借出，不要再有所希望：如此，你们的赏报必定丰厚，且要成为至高者的子女，因为他对待忘恩的和恶人，是仁慈的。

text_en: Be merciful, just as your Father is merciful.
text_cn: 你们应当慈悲，就像你们的父那样慈悲。

text_en: “Do not judge, and you will not be judged; do not condemn, and you will not be condemned. Forgive, and you will be forgiven;
text_cn: 你们不要判断，你们也就不受判断；不要定罪，也就不被定罪；你们要赦免，也就蒙赦免。

text_en: give, and it will be given to you. A good measure, pressed down, shaken together, running over, will be put into your lap; for the measure you give will be the measure you get back. ”
text_cn: 你们给，也就给你们；并且还要用好的，连按带摇，以致外溢的升斗，倒在你们的怀里，因为你们用什么升斗量，也用什么升斗量给你们。

text_en: He also told them a parable: “Can a blind person guide a blind person? Will not both fall into a pit?
text_cn: 他又向他们讲比喻说：“瞎子岂能给瞎子领路？不是两人都要跌在坑里吗？

text_en: A disciple is not above the teacher, but everyone who is fully qualified will be like the teacher.
text_cn: 没有徒弟胜过师傅的：凡受过完备教育的，仅相似自己的师傅而已。

text_en: Why do you see the speck in your neighbor’s eye, but do not notice the log in your own eye?
text_cn: 怎么，你看见你兄弟眼中的木屑，而你眼中的大梁，倒不理会呢？

text_en: Or how can you say to your neighbor, ‘Friend, let me take out the speck in your eye, ’ when you yourself do not see the log in your own eye? You hypocrite, first take the log out of your own eye, and then you will see clearly to take the speck out of your neighbor’s eye.
text_cn: 你怎能对你的兄弟说：兄弟，让我取出你眼中的木屑罢！而你竟看不见自己眼中的大梁呢？假善人啊！先取出你眼中的大梁，然后才看得清楚，以便取出你兄弟眼中的木屑。

text_en: “No good tree bears bad fruit, nor again does a bad tree bear good fruit;
text_cn: 没有好树结坏果子的，也没有坏树结好果子的。

text_en: for each tree is known by its own fruit. Figs are not gathered from thorns, nor are grapes picked from a bramble bush.
text_cn: 每一棵树，凭它的果子就可认出来。人从荆棘上收不到无花果，从茨藤上也剪不到葡萄。

text_en: The good person out of the good treasure of the heart produces good, and the evil person out of evil treasure produces evil; for it is out of the abundance of the heart that the mouth speaks.
text_cn: 善人从自己心中的善库发出善来，恶人从恶库中发出恶来，因为心里充满什么，口里就说什么。

text_en: “Why do you call me ‘Lord, Lord, ’ and do not do what I tell you?
text_cn: 你们为什么称呼我：主啊！主啊！而不行我所吩咐的呢？”

text_en: I will show you what someone is like who comes to me, hears my words, and acts on them.
text_cn: “凡到我跟前，听了我的道理，而实行的，我要给你们指出，他相似什么人：

text_en: That one is like a man building a house, who dug deeply and laid the foundation on rock; when a flood arose, the river burst against that house but could not shake it, because it had been well built.
text_cn: 他相似一个建筑房屋的人，掘地深挖，把基础立在磐石上，洪水瀑发时，大水冲击那座房屋，而不能动摇它，因为它建筑的好。

text_en: But the one who hears and does not act is like a man who built a house on the ground without a foundation. When the river burst against it, immediately it fell, and great was the ruin of that house. ”
text_cn: 但那听了而不实行的，相似在平地上不打基础，而建筑房屋的人，洪水一冲击，那房屋立刻倾倒，且破坏的很惨。”
